Subject: Renewal evidence & temporary attestation — timeline for PO and bridge acceptance

Hi Dana —

Congrats on getting internal approval to move forward. Quick note on next steps for Greenline’s renewal: procurement has asked for the latest Type II report, and they also require either a Type II window that covers through the renewal date or a bridge/attestation that covers the gap.

I’m attaching our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf) and a short draft bridge-letter that legal usually signs for time-limited coverage (bridge-letter-draft-Greenline.docx). Can you confirm:

- Is your PO target still 12/15/2026?
- Would your procurement team accept a signed bridge letter plus an executed PO, or do they need the full Type II report delivered before PO issuance?

If the PO needs to land before our next Type II window closes, we can fast-track a signed bridge and provide scoped evidence bundles for your auditors. Monica (cc) will scope out the evidence pack once you confirm the acceptance path.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, bridge-letter-draft-Greenline.docx

Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & temporary attestation — timeline for PO and bridge acceptance

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the quick response and the attachments. Confirming PO target is 12/15/2026; finance needs at least an interim attestation or bridge that covers the period from 12/15/2026 through 01/31/2027, since our contract term begins on 01/01/2027 and we need audit coverage for the start of the term.

Two questions:
1) Will the bridge-letter include an explicit coverage window and scope (storage/processing only)?
2) Our auditors may request evidence for controls that changed in Q3 — is it feasible to provide a scoped evidence bundle (logs, change control excerpts, and configuration snapshots) within 7 business days of signing?

If yes to both, procurement can accept a signed bridge + PO. Otherwise, finance will push PO until the full report is available.

Dana Li
Senior Procurement Manager, Greenline Therapeutics
procurement@greenline.co

Hi Dana —

Yes, we can provide both items. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:
- Bridge letter: we typically include an explicit coverage window and scope phrasing ("coverage limited to systems and services in-scope for SOC 2 Type II report, limited to storage and processing functions"), plus a signature block for Redwood legal. The coverage dates you requested (12/15/2026–01/31/2027) are feasible.
- Evidence bundle: we can assemble logs (retention-limited extracts), change-control snippets, and configuration snapshots. We will exclude any customer PII from the bundle; redactions will be noted. Target delivery: 5 business days after the bridge is signed if you provide a named POC for evidence ingestion.

Please confirm the POC and email for evidence transfer (SFTP or secure SharePoint preferred). Also flag any control IDs your auditors are focused on (e.g., change mgmt, access reviews, backup verification).

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement-playbook.xlsx (internal checklist for evidence handoff)

Monica — that works. POC for evidence transfer will be Marco Ruiz (techops@greenline.co). He has SFTP access and will confirm the directory after we sign. Our auditors want emphasis on change management and user provisioning controls (we'll send specific control IDs by EOD).

We are OK with the 5-business-day window. Procurement will prepare a PO contingent on a signed bridge + evidence delivery plan.

Dana

On a practical note: do you have a short-form bridge we can route for internal approval? If legal signs the draft quickly we can issue the PO to meet 12/15.
